source_question: OWR-3473-009; Scott joint with Tateno, ordinary triangle count
claim: For fixed p in (0,1) and every sequence of positive integer moduli q_n, max_a |q_n P(T=a mod q_n)-1| tends to zero exactly when q_n=o(n^2).
stronger_verified_result: A modular Gaussian folding LLT uniform over all q>=1 at scale min(q,sigma), including explicit critical wrapped-normal discrepancy and supercritical divergence.
mechanism: Authentic quantitative ordinary-copy LLT plus elementary bounded-difference tails and Gaussian Poisson folding. Necessity independently follows from the edge projection and the first Fourier coefficient.
deep_import: Sah–Sawhney arXiv:2006.11369v1, Theorem 1.1, specialized to K3 in G(n,p); the deep LLT proof is not reproved.

considered_unused_route.route: Directly reuse source Lemma 4.1 as an independent-model characteristic-function bound
considered_unused_route.gap: That lemma uses the fixed-size-model statistics and their sigma; no unchanged transfer to the full G(n,p) sigma is claimed. The completed route uses Theorem 1.1 instead.

adjacent_fixed_H_conjecture: Its blanket ordinary Gaussian LLT part is false for 2K2; the known Sah–Sawhney obstruction is reconstructed with ordinary-copy counting. No new discovery is attributed to it.
fresh_checks: 33,864 graph configurations through n=6; 12 exact p,n cases; all tested finite Fourier identities and 21 Gaussian Poisson comparisons passed.
remaining_gap_for_stated_question: None once the explicit established theorem is admitted as a standard result.
novelty_or_priority_verdict: NOT_DETERMINED; no whole-literature priority search; substantial explicit prior credit identified.
